games.note: Optional. With Bloons TD 6 installed on Steam, towers and bloons use real BTD6 art converted locally from your own copy.

components.label: BTD6 art converter (makes @bloonsops_btd6 from your own Bloons TD 6)

notes.firstLaunch: On Arma 3's main menu, click the red PLAY BLOONS OPS button at the top to play solo (it is also under Singleplayer > Scenarios). For co-op, the host picks Multiplayer > Host > Bloons Ops - Co-op 1-4, and friends join that server. If you own Bloons TD 6 on Steam, the BLOONS TD towers and the bloons show as real BTD6 art made from your own copy (re-run @bloonsops/btd6/bloonsops_btd6.exe after a BTD6 update).

setup.note: Converts your own Bloons TD 6 monkey and bloon art into a local mod. Nothing is uploaded. Without BTD6 it just creates an empty @bloonsops_btd6 and the game keeps its own look.
